name: Sigil of Thoradin
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The reconstruction worked flawlessly. The sigil can now be used to unlock the seal on Trollbane's tomb. Return it to Zengu, no doubt he has additional tasks for you to complete.
narrative.objectives: Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: We're halfway to being able to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb. We are not exactly sure where the third sigil is, as its holders seem to move around Arathi quite a bit, but I have faith that you'll be able to find it.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer! Do you have the second sigil?

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 42, 18,920 XP in all.

quests.name: Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.

quests.name: Sigil of Strom
quests.objectiveText: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: The Broken Sigil
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Thoradin
quests.objectiveText: Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Arathor
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Trol'kalar
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.

quests.name: Trol'kalar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
